Initial release of Maker Online Free — AI-powered video creation and export tool.

- Upload images or clips (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 500MB) for instant AI video creation.
- Give simple instructions (e.g., "combine these into a 30-second promo video with music and text"); export finished 1080p MP4 videos.
- Automatic token and session setup for fast, anonymous use (free 7-day token).
- Supports balance checks, upload, timeline editing, track summaries, and cloud rendering pipeline.
- Fully online, no editing software or downloads required; optimized for small businesses and content creators.
